_comment: B12 Memory System -- Kimi Code CLI MCP Server Configuration
_note_python: Set VENV_PYTHON to the Python interpreter that has the 'mcp' package installed
_note_script: Set MCP_SERVER_SCRIPT to the deployed b12_mcp_server.py path
_install: Copy B12 block into ~/.kimi/mcp.json under mcpServers, or run: kimi mcp add --transport stdio B12 -- /path/to/python3 /path/to/b12_mcp_server.py
